/* Generated by DSA Ladder's judge. Runs the user's Solution against test cases read from stdin.
   Protocol (stdout):  "@@R <test> <nanos>" + newline + <json result>
                       "@@O <test>" + newline + <json string of what the user printed>
                       "@@E <test>" + newline + <json string describing the exception>          */
public class JudgeMain {
    static final PrintStream REAL = new PrintStream(new FileOutputStream(FileDescriptor.out), false);

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Thread th = new Thread(null, () -> {
            try { run(); } catch (Throwable e) { REAL.print("@@E -1\n" + J.str(String.valueOf(e)) + "\n"); }
            REAL.flush();
        }, "judge", 512L << 20);
        th.start();
        th.join();
        REAL.flush();
        System.exit(0);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    static void run() throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in), 1 << 16);
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        ByteArrayOutputStream userOut = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        PrintStream cap = new PrintStream(new Capped(userOut, 64 * 1024), true);
        System.setOut(cap);
        System.setErr(cap);
        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {
            List<Object> a = (List<Object>) J.parse(br.readLine());
            userOut.reset();
            long st = System.nanoTime();
            Object res;
            try {
                res = call(a);
            } catch (Throwable e) {
                cap.flush();
                if (userOut.size() > 0) REAL.print("@@O " + t + "\n" + J.str(userOut.toString()) + "\n");
                REAL.print("@@E " + t + "\n" + J.str(describe(e)) + "\n");
                REAL.flush();
                return;
            }
            long el = System.nanoTime() - st;
            cap.flush();
            if (userOut.size() > 0) REAL.print("@@O " + t + "\n" + J.str(userOut.toString()) + "\n");
            REAL.print("@@R " + t + " " + el + "\n" + J.str(res) + "\n");
            REAL.flush();
        }
    }

    static String describe(Throwable e) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(e.getClass().getName());
        if (e.getMessage() != null) sb.append(": ").append(e.getMessage());
        for (StackTraceElement el : e.getStackTrace()) {
            if ("JudgeMain".equals(el.getClassName()) || el.getClassName().startsWith("JudgeMain$")) break;
            if (el.getClassName().startsWith("java.") || el.getClassName().startsWith("jdk.")) continue;
            sb.append("\n  at ").append(el.getClassName()).append('.').append(el.getMethodName())
              .append(" (line ").append(el.getLineNumber()).append(')');
            if (sb.length() > 600) break;
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    static final class Capped extends OutputStream {
        final ByteArrayOutputStream o; final int max;
        Capped(ByteArrayOutputStream o, int max) { this.o = o; this.max = max; }
        public void write(int b) { if (o.size() < max) o.write(b); }
        public void write(byte[] b, int off, int len) { int k = Math.min(len, max - o.size()); if (k > 0) o.write(b, off, k); }
    }

    /*__CALL__*/
}

        }
        if (c == '"') {
            p[0]++; StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            while (true) {
                char d = s.charAt(p[0]++);
                if (d == '"') return sb.toString();
                if (d == '\\') {
                    char e = s.charAt(p[0]++);
                    if (e == 'n') sb.append('\n'); else if (e == 't') sb.append('\t'); else if (e == 'r') sb.append('\r');
                    else if (e == 'u') { sb.append((char) Integer.parseInt(s.substring(p[0], p[0] + 4), 16)); p[0] += 4; }
                    else sb.append(e);
                } else sb.append(d);
            }
        }
        if (s.startsWith("true", p[0])) { p[0] += 4; return Boolean.TRUE; }
        if (s.startsWith("false", p[0])) { p[0] += 5; return Boolean.FALSE; }
        if (s.startsWith("null", p[0])) { p[0] += 4; return null; }
        int st = p[0]; boolean frac = false;
        while (p[0] < s.length()) {
            char d = s.charAt(p[0]);
            if ((d >= '0' && d <= '9') || d == '-') p[0]++;
            else if (d == '.' || d == 'e' || d == 'E' || d == '+') { frac = true; p[0]++; }
            else break;
        }
        String t = s.substring(st, p[0]);
        return frac ? (Object) Double.parseDouble(t) : (Object) Long.parseLong(t);

    static TreeNode toTreeNode(Object o) {

        }

    static void w(StringBuilder sb, Object v, int depth) {

        if (v instanceof String s) { q(sb, s); return; }
        if (v instanceof Character c) { q(sb, String.valueOf(c)); return; }

    static void q(StringBuilder sb, String s) {
        sb.append('"');
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '"') sb.append("\\\""); else if (c == '\\') sb.append("\\\\"); else if (c == '\n') sb.append("\\n");
            else if (c == '\r') sb.append("\\r"); else if (c == '\t') sb.append("\\t");
            else if (c < 0x20) sb.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c)); else sb.append(c);
        }
        sb.append('"');
    }
